title: Argentinian Chicken Casserole with Chestnut and Oozy Sauce
description: A unique Indian-inspired casserole made with Argentinian chicken, chestnut, and a creamy oozy sauce, all wrapped up in a delicious peppery crust.

ingredients.name: Oozy sauce (made from cream and cheese)

instructions: In a bowl, mix together cumin powder, turmeric powder, and salt.
Rub the spice mixture on the Argentinian chicken breast.
Heat coconut oil in a pan and cook the chicken breast until browned.
In a separate pan, heat the oozy sauce over low heat.
In a greased casserole dish, arrange the cooked chicken breast.
Pour the heated oozy sauce over the chicken breast.
Mix together chestnut flour and a little water to make a thick paste.
Spread the chestnut paste on top of the casserole.
Sprinkle peppercorns on top of the casserole.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
